conditions.scope: Physical dedicated server with exact Connectivity1.20.1-7.6; only direct terminal socket IO, never decoder/protocol exceptions.

change.summary: Close terminated socket IO without disconnect-write recursion or malformed-IP strikes.

modifiers.before: Connectivity counts Broken pipe and Connection reset by peer as malformed traffic. Repeated disconnect-write failures can enter its process-lifetime IP block, which silently freezes subsequent channels for30s.
modifiers.after: Direct terminal IOException or ClosedChannelException closes its channel once before native disconnect writes and malformed counting. Decoder/protocol errors and all authentication/packet checks keep native handling.

rationale.purpose: Prevent a dropped pack/login socket from making future legitimate connections unreachable.
rationale.decision_source: User reports connection reset and no download, then challenges restarting without a fix. Codex selects a terminal-IO boundary from installed Connectivity7.6 bytecode and live repeated Broken pipe followed by blocked-IP evidence.

introduced.summary: Close terminal socket IO before Connectivity counts errors or Minecraft writes a disconnect to the broken transport.

history.summary: Close terminal socket IO before Connectivity counts errors or Minecraft writes a disconnect to the broken transport.

relations: socket termination -> close once -> future native login/review remains reachable
notes: No registry, channel, packet, authentication, TLS, or native client trust-policy change; client artifact remains compatible.
Stable maintainer active token a945410 and its localhost origin are preserved. Prelaunch refusal to install unverified JARs is separate and requires native remote review.
unresolved: Live player acceptance and initial peer-reset trigger remain unproven; this does not cure external network resets or accept unverified JARs for the player.
